implementation_statement: No OT access control policy existed. POL-02 (P06) was approved 2026-08-31 and covers OT; OT procedures (remote access, vendor sessions) are due 2026-11-30.

The SCADA application separates operator (control) and viewer roles. Gap: all operators share one role and account, so gate commands cannot be tied to a person.
